description: This file contains Makefile snippets and macro definitions related to building root filesystem images, including conditional logic for MKLIBS, opkg, apk, and rootfs preparation scripts.

methods.name: mklibs
methods.description: Defines a macro to build and process libraries and programs for the root filesystem, including finding executables and shared objects, stripping libraries, and copying them to target directories.

methods.name: opkg
methods.description: Defines a macro for configuring the opkg package manager with specific options for installation root and architecture.

methods.name: apk
methods.description: Defines a macro for configuring the apk package manager with specific options for root, keys, and cache preservation.

methods.name: clean_ipkg
methods.description: Defines a macro to clean up opkg package info files, remove unnecessary files, and update status files.

methods.name: prepare_rootfs
methods.description: Defines a macro to prepare the root filesystem, including copying files, running post-install scripts, enabling/disabling init scripts, cleaning version control directories, and invoking other macros for cleanup and library building.
